expected_behavior: If a browser already answers on the debugging port, the skill attaches to it instead of launching a second one.
Chrome is launched with a dedicated profile under ~/.o-skills/chrome-profile, never the user's own profile.
The user's running browser processes are never killed.
The app URL comes from the README, config or environment, and the dev server is checked before the browser opens.
--stop ends only the browser this skill launched from its own profile, and a dev server the agent started is stopped when the work is done.
